Купля-продажа б/у и нового снаряжения. **Stack:** Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x, SQLAlchemy 2.x async, PostgreSQL **Scale:** с нуля **Your focus:** CVE в зависимостях, устаревшие пакеты, лицензии --- ## Code is included below — start immediately, no need to request it. ### bot/config.py ```python import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() BOT_TOKEN: str = os.environ["BOT_TOKEN"] DATABASE_URL: str = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] ADMIN_ID: int = int(os.environ.get("ADMIN_ID", "")) LOG_LEVEL: str = os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO") ``` ### bot/handlers/start.py ```python from aiogram import Router from aiogram.filters import CommandStart from aiogram.types import Message router = Router() @router.message(CommandStart()) async def cmd_start(msg: Message): await msg.answer( f"👋 Привет, {msg.from_user.first_name}!\n\n" f"🎣 FishMarket\nМаркетплейс снастей.\n\n" "Бот в разработке. Скоро запустим!", parse_mode="HTML", ) ``` ### bot/models.py ```python """FishMarket — маркетплейс снастей: объявления, поиск, сделки.""" from datetime import datetime from sqlalchemy import ( Column, Integer, BigInteger, String, Text, DateTime, Boolean, Float, ForeignKey, Index, Enum as SAEnum ) from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, relationship import enum class Base(DeclarativeBase): pass class ListingStatus(str, enum.Enum): ACTIVE = "active" SOLD = "sold" RESERVED = "reserved" EXPIRED = "expired" class ListingCategory(str, enum.Enum): ROD = "rod" # Удочки и спиннинги REEL = "reel" # Катушки LURE = "lure" # Приманки и блёсна LINE = "line" # Леска и шнуры HOOK = "hook" # Крючки FLOAT = "float" # Поплавки BOAT = "boat" # Лодки ELECTRONICS = "electronics" # Эхолоты, GPS CLOTHING = "clothing" # Одежда OTHER = "other" CATEGORY_LABELS = { ListingCategory.ROD: "🎣 Удочки/спиннинги", ListingCategory.REEL: "🔄 Катушки", ListingCategory.LURE: "🪝 Приманки/блёсна", ListingCategory.LINE: "〰️ Леска/шнуры", ListingCategory.HOOK: "🪝 Крючки", ListingCategory.FLOAT: "🔴 Поплавки", ListingCategory.BOAT: "⛵ Лодки", ListingCategory.ELECTRONICS: "📡 Эхолоты/GPS", ListingCategory.CLOTHING: "🧥 Одежда", ListingCategory.OTHER: "📦 Прочее", } class User(Base): __tablename__ = "users" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True) tg_id = Column(BigInteger, unique=True, nullable=False, index=True) username = Column(String(64)) full_name = Column(String(128)) phone = Column(String(32)) # для связи rating = Column(Float, default=5.0) # рейтинг продавца deals_count = Column(Integer, default=0) created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) listings = relationship("Listing", back_populates="seller", lazy="raise") class Listing(Base): """Объявление о продаже.""" __tablename__ = "listings" ``` ### main.py ```python #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ FishMarket Bot — Маркетплейс снастей. """ import asyncio import logging from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher from aiogram.fsm.storage.memory import MemoryStorage from bot.config import BOT_TOKEN, LOG_LEVEL from bot.handlers import start logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, LOG_LEVEL)) log = logging.getLogger(__name__) async def main(): bot = Bot(token=BOT_TOKEN) dp = Dispatcher(storage=MemoryStorage()) dp.include_router(start.router) log.info("FishMarket starting...") await dp.start_polling(bot) if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(main()) ``` --- ## Your task Analyze the code above.
